limitations: One deterministic seed per scenario; no distribution over seeds.
Only32nominal samples spanning0.494512ms, about15.5maintenance intervals; acquisition excluded.
All emulated modules on a board share its physical clock. Injected per-node logical drift is distinct from physical oscillator drift.
Phased scenarios sample all registered outputs at a common simulator instant; phase/quantization contributes to truth error.
Jitter case also changes phase and logical drift; their separate contributions are not identifiable from this matrix.
No injected losses, link outages, asymmetric clock frequencies or phase-noise model in these focused scenarios.
Logical error at simultaneous time is not automatically the oscilloscope delta between matched epoch pulses.
Anchor is included in aggregate valid-row counts and is always zero error by definition; follower-only coverage is reported separately.
The alternating drift pattern makes the K2 final node +4000ppb relative to its anchor while the K3 final node has zero relative drift, so end-node comparisons do not isolate capacity.
Ideal symmetric zero-error and coherent-asymmetry linear bias are controlled RTL outcomes, not a fitted law for physical jitter or long-term synchronization.
